== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[SW-4 Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. The earlier slip and the same area of the new card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
